name: break-the-chain
description: A Chrome (MV3) extension that finds broken links, dead anchors and redirect chains on any page — or across a whole site.
author: Guy Cohen

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts
scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../break-the-chain.zip . -x '.*'
